description:
These 6x6 terracotta wall tiles are square, natural handmade terracotta pieces measuring 6 x 6 inches, made for bathroom walls, shower areas and splashbacks where a classic mid-size square looks right.

## How they look
Handmade terracotta tends to vary slightly in shade and edge from tile to tile, so a wall of them looks warm and hand-finished rather than printed. The natural finish keeps the earthy clay colour without a glaze. At 6 inches, they sit between small mosaic-like tiles and larger squares, giving a classic pattern that suits both small and medium bathrooms.

## Where they work
- **Full bathroom walls** in square terracotta bathroom tiles for a warm, rustic room.
- **Shower walls** once sealed, paired with a plain floor.
- **Kitchen or vanity splashbacks** in handmade terracotta wall tiles with a matte clay wall tile finish.

Unglazed clay is porous, so in a bathroom it works best once sealed; a good sealer generally keeps splashes and soap marks from soaking in, and the matte surface stays calm next to brass or black fittings.

## Good to know
- Size: 6 x 6 inches (as listed)
- Material: natural handmade terracotta
- Shape: square
- Category: bathroom wall terracotta tiles

Seal the tiles before grouting so grout does not stain the clay, then reseal as your fixer advises. Clean with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner; avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour range of the 6x6 terracotta wall tiles, then get a dated quote. Compare with the [6x6 inch hexagon version](/products/6x6-inch-hexagon-natural-handmade-terracotta-bathroom-wall-tiles) or browse the [terracotta bathroom range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of 6x6 terracotta wall tiles?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can natural terracotta be used on a bathroom wall?
faqs.a: Yes, once it is sealed. Unglazed clay is porous, so a penetrating sealer before grouting and an occasional reseal help keep water and soap from marking it.

faqs.q: Square or hexagon 6x6 terracotta tiles: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Square tiles give a clean grid that is quicker to lay; hexagons give a more decorative pattern but take more cutting at the wall edges.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "6x6 Square Natural Terracotta" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
